text:
Evan Bouchard ranks third among all 522 skaters in one surprising place: wins added by his goals. He has 11 goals in 20 games, 33 points, and plays 25 and a half minutes a night for an Oilers team that has found its footing after a rough October. An Oilers Nation awards poll this week had him first for the Norris.

Now the uncomfortable part. Those 11 goals came on 3.9 expected. He's shooting 20%, double last season's rate, and Edmonton has scored 24 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Our talent range has his true finishing closer to 9%. Some of these will turn back into point shots that hit pads.

What doesn't need luck is how he moves the puck. Edmonton controls 59% of the five-on-five expected goals with him out there, Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 59% of his entries last season, and Evolving-Hockey had him fifth among defensemen. He's a top-pairing driver on any team. Just expect the goal column to slow while the assists keep coming.
headline: A Norris case built on a shooting heater
